method: For every direct call to a proven WGSERVER import thunk, walk backward through the bounded local setup window, collect x86 PUSH operands in nearest-first callee argument order, classify each argument source, and aggregate stable position profiles across WCC/WBB counterparts.
interpretation_limits: Nearest-first PUSH order is valid for ordinary x86 stack arguments but does not recover register arguments, hidden arguments, or arguments prepared outside the bounded window.
A stable source category does not prove an exact C type, signedness, pointee type, or ownership lifetime.
Stable immediate values identify caller constants only; they do not recover enum names or semantic meaning.
Exact prototypes still require matching Worldgroup binaries, symbols, headers, or dynamic traces.
